SOLR-10639: Fix NPE in LRU/LFU/FastLRU caches toString method

Here is the root cause:
The bug is caused by a lack of proper null checks in the `toString` methods of the cache classes (LFUCache, LRUCache, FastLRUCache). When `cacheMap` is null, attempting to call `cacheMap.getValue()` results in a NullPointerException, which occurs when the method tries to return a string representation of the cache. The original code did not encapsulate the null check properly, leading to the possibility of dereferencing a null object.

Here is the patch:
 
   @Override
   public String toString() {
-    return name() + cacheMap != null ? cacheMap.getValue().toString() : "";
+    return name() + (cacheMap != null ? cacheMap.getValue().toString() : "");
   }
